catalog_loading_benchmark.method: Alternating fresh isolated Python processes, same 10 original r2 files, normal loader and GC enabled; timing includes full integrity validation and building all indexes and excludes bundle discovery and fingerprint audit. macOS ru_maxrss in bytes, captured immediately after all 10 loads. Every dataclass field compared with deterministic SHA256 including every raw/fill mask, digest, lookup entry, alias map and object reference into the template tuple. No skipped validation, runtime cache or font resource changes.

dxf_regression.method: Fresh recognition of original saved DXFs, all ten unchanged r2 catalogs loaded normally then reused within this in-process regression harness. Full report equality, full entitydb tags except validated writer timestamp, and every original modelspace entity compared against rc32. This is 100 DXF recognitions, not 100 PDF conversions.

pdf_regression.method: Reconvert four original PDFs through Converter with normal font-bundle loading. Two open-font 193-character stroke/fill PDFs and two existing private local drawing pages use identical source SHA256 and requests as rc32. Compare every recognition field except elapsed time and all DXF group pairs except two HEADER GUIDs; revalidate saved scale/dimension checks. Private input paths and names excluded.

limits: This optimization reduces repeated Unicode/index construction work; it does not increase recognized character coverage.
Short all-ten-catalog corpus remains 69/84 complete: 14 cases lack an independent font lock and one has a large internal punctuation conflict.
Two private drawing pages retain zero external font locks; one passes its scale gate, one fails its dimension error gate.
The 4290-document/12577-page historical corpus, original BIM22 and 84 matching-face PDFs are not rerun.
Performance results are local macOS ARM64/Python 3.12.13 observations for ten r2 catalogs, not a cross-platform speed guarantee.
Full-tree Ruff retains 29 rc32 findings in unchanged files; changed runtime/test files pass.
